text:
deploybot: Upcoming rollout: storage-gateway v5.2.1 -> prod (canary 23:15 UTC, ramp 23:45).
incident-bot: New incident INC-9012: eu-west index-gc causing intermittent 503s and write timeouts.
nora: ops asked to hold any deploys that touch index-gc or GC config flags.
sam: v5.2.1 toggles adaptive_gc which touches that codepath. stopping promotion now.
release_mgr: please pin the release slot to v5.2.0 and mark v5.2.1 as quarantined in internal notes.
deploybot: Action: `pause rollout storage-gateway v5.2.1` executed. Rollout paused. Slot pinned to v5.2.0. Auto-promote disabled.
eng_prod_oncall: quick triage: GC threads spiking CPU during compaction -> some requests timed out. Testing a mitigation that reduces GC parallelism in eu cluster. ETA 20m.
nora: good. release team hold publishing release notes until incident cleared. we don't want customers to see the rollout blurb.
sam: if rollback needed run `deploybot promote storage-gateway v5.2.0 --force --reason "INC-9012 index-gc"` and then run `storage-verify --region eu-west` after.
release_mgr: schedule change window moved from 23:15 -> 02:00 UTC tentatively. will update calendar and notify stakeholders once triage completes.
eng_prod_oncall: mitigation looks promising in staging (reduced GC concurrency). propose a micro-canary 1% in 60m if staging stays green.
nora: prefer staged ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 40% with tight SLO gates and kill-switch at 2x error rate. put circuit breaker thresholds in the canary policy.
sam: adding kill-switch command to runbook: `deploybot abort rollout storage-gateway v5.2.1` and `deploybot promote storage-gateway v5.2.0 --reason "abort"`.
incident-bot: INC-9012 updated: investigation ongoing (labels: index-gc, eu-west, high).
deploybot: Reminder: pinned slots prevent scheduled promotions. Use `deploybot unpin storage-gateway` to allow promotions.
release_mgr: internal comms draft ready but blocked until we confirm impact. will drop to #support once we have clarity.
eng_prod_oncall: if rollback is performed, we'll run `kv-repair --verify-only --region eu-west` to confirm no data drift.
nora: OK team, next status update in 20m or on any change. keep convo here unless customer-facing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: :thumbsup:
release_mgr: :lock:
